adjudication.rationale: Looking at the diff in handleCancelBooking.ts around line 449, the code iterates over `bookingCalendarReference` (now an array of calendar references) with `for (const reference of bookingCalendarReference)`. Inside this loop, when handling recurring events with `allRemainingBookings`, there's a nested loop that iterates over ALL user credentials (`bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(credential => credential.type.endsWith('_calendar'))`), and for each credential, it loops through ALL `updatedBookings`. This means if there are multiple calendar references, the entire recurring event deletion logic runs multiple times - once per reference - causing duplicate delete requests for the same calendar events. The finding correctly identifies this as a bug that could cause duplicate remote delete requests.
